title: Genome-wide identification and expression analysis of NRT2 gene family in Tartary buckwheat suggests the potential role of FtNTR2.4 in low nitrogen response.
authors: Xu, Daiying; Zou, Yaoxuan; Hu, Nan; Li, Han; Yin, Junjie; Wang, Jiting; Wu, Xi; Xiang, Dabing; Zhao, Jianglin; Zheng, Xiaoqin; Wan, Yan; Liu, Yanxia; Liu, Changying
journal: Physiology and molecular biology of plants : an international journal of functional plant biology
one_liner_zh: 该文对苦荞NRT2基因家族进行全基因组鉴定与表达分析，并初步验证转录因子FtNF-YB8与FtNRT2.4启动子的结合，但核心是基因家族功能与表达调控，缺乏TF-DNA三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅部分涉及蛋白-DNA结合实验。
abstract: Nitrate transporters play important roles in nitrogen (N) uptake and utilization in plants. The function of nitrate transporter 2 (NRT2) in model plants under low-N (LN) conditions has been studied, but there are few studies on non-model plants, including Tartary buckwheat (an important medicinal and edible crop). In this study, seven NRT2 genes were identified in Tartary buckwheat genome. All the FtNRT2 proteins were localized to the cell membrane with 10-12 transmembrane domains, and have the common structural characteristics of NRT2. Expression analysis showed FtNRT2.1 was expressed in all tissues, FtNRT2.3/2.4 were specifically expressed in roots, and FtNRT2.6/2.7 were specifically expressed in seeds. Under LN, the expression of FtNRT2.1/2.4 was induced, while FtNRT2.3 was suppressed. The root-specific expressed gene FtNRT2.4 may be the key NRT2 member for regulating LN response by sequence, molecular docking, and expression analysis. Overexpression of FtNRT2.4 in tobacco improved plant growth and N uptake under 0 and 5 mM N conditions. An ancillary protein of FtNRT2.4, FtNRT3.2, was characterized by yeast two-hybrid and firefly luciferase complementation assays. In addition, 14 transcription factors (TFs) may involve in the regulation of FtNRT2.4 expression by co-expression analysis. FtNF-YB8, a TF localized in cytoplasm and nucleus, can bind to the promoter of FtNRT2.4 by yeast one-hybrid analysis. Dual-luciferase reporter analysis showed that FtNF-YB8 improved the expression of FtNRT2.4. These findings indicated the important role of FtNRT2.4 in LN response and provide new insights into the regulatory function of NRT2. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s12298-025-01670-7.
abstract_zh: 硝酸盐转运蛋白在植物的氮（N）吸收和利用中发挥重要作用。硝酸盐转运蛋白2（NRT2）在模式植物低氮（LN）条件下的功能已被研究，但对非模式植物（包括苦荞，一种重要的药食两用作物）的研究较少。本研究在苦荞基因组中鉴定出7个NRT2基因。所有FtNRT2蛋白均定位于细胞膜，具有10-12个跨膜结构域，并具备NRT2的常见结构特征。表达分析显示，FtNRT2.1在所有组织中表达，FtNRT2.3/2.4在根中特异性表达，而FtNRT2.6/2.7在种子中特异性表达。在低氮条件下，FtNRT2.1/2.4的表达被诱导，而FtNRT2.3的表达受到抑制。通过序列、分子对接和表达分析，根特异性表达基因FtNRT2.4可能是调控低氮响应的关键NRT2成员。在烟草中过表达FtNRT2.4，在0和5 mM氮条件下改善了植物生长和氮吸收。通过酵母双杂交和萤火虫荧光素酶互补实验，鉴定出FtNRT2.4的一个辅助蛋白FtNRT3.2。此外，通过共表达分析，14个转录因子（TFs）可能参与调控FtNRT2.4的表达。FtNF-YB8，一种定位于细胞质和细胞核的转录因子，通过酵母单杂交分析可结合FtNRT2.4的启动子。双荧光素酶报告分析显示，FtNF-YB8提高了FtNRT2.4的表达。这些发现表明FtNRT2.4在低氮响应中的重要作用，并为NRT2的调控功能提供了新见解。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可访问10.1007/s12298-025-01670-7获取。
